explanation: Copy each monotone run and reverse the decreasing ones. Merge their current heads with a min-heap, advancing only the run that supplied the latest output. The input list is preserved.
timeComplexity: O(n log(r+1)), for r monotone runs
spaceComplexity: O(n) run copies and output plus O(r) heap
attribution: Original Java implementation and explanation for EPI Practice, based on the displayed public contract and our independently authored C# solution; no upstream reference code adapted.
